title: Backend Service Plan Docs Retirement Checklist

items.label: Capture the Project Control cleanup path and Backend owner before editing.
items.evidenceTarget: Work path, owner repository, active role, Phase target, Checklist target, and Evidence target are identified before editing Backend Markdown.
items.verificationNote: Identified Work path flowdoc-product-development-resumption > flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup, owner repo-backend, active role documentation-synthesizer, phase target phase-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-backend-service-plan-retirement, checklist target checklist-flowdoc-documentation-authority-cleanup-backend-service-plan-retirement, and evidence target evidence-backend-service-plan-doc-retired-2026-08-31.

items.label: Write a failing Backend documentation authority guard before deleting the plan.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused Backend documentation authority test fails before the docs/superpowers plan is retired.
items.verificationNote: RED evidence included npm run test -- src/tests/backendDocumentationAuthority.test.ts failing because docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-27-backend-service-contract-hardening.md still existed.

items.label: Retire the one Backend docs/superpowers service hardening plan.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend commit deletes the backend service hardening plan and leaves Backend docs/superpowers empty.
items.verificationNote: Backend commit c24f7f000a8b8e9a181434dd95d7611afa026a75 deletes docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-27-backend-service-contract-hardening.md, and rg --files docs/superpowers reports no Backend docs/superpowers path.

items.label: Preserve retained Backend readiness context in a bounded repo-owned document.
items.evidenceTarget: Backend AGENTS.md points future shared Markdown work to Project Control, and docs/BACKEND_SERVICE_READINESS_BOUNDARY.md carries Authority Boundary wording.
items.verificationNote: Backend AGENTS.md now points to docs/domains/flowdoc-documentation-authority-policy.md, and docs/BACKEND_SERVICE_READINESS_BOUNDARY.md states it is repo-backend local scope, not product evidence, and points to evidence-backend-service-contract-hardening-2026-08-27.

items.label: Verify Backend worktree and merged main gates.
items.evidenceTarget: Focused docs tests, Backend worktree npm run check, and merged Backend main npm run check pass after cleanup.
items.verificationNote: Focused Backend docs/readiness gate passed 3 files and 7 tests. Backend worktree npm run check passed after supplying the expected sibling Core fixture path for worktree-only tests. Backend merged main npm run check eventually passed type-check, 90 passed test files, 1 skipped file, 325 passed tests, 24 skipped tests, and build after removing the temporary Core junction and rerunning a flaky concurrency test.

items.label: Record the Backend cleanup in Project Control without promoting product truth.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control evidence cites the Backend commit, files, verification, deleted path, temporary junction risk, and boundaries intentionally not promoted.
items.verificationNote: Evidence is work-scoped with nodeIds [] and keeps Core, Backend, Editor, compatibility, frontend readiness, FlowDoc product truth, and map truth unpromoted.
